The accepted cold tagged fixture has one explicit delta: pin only schema, excluding the parsed outer positive AUTO_INCREMENT allocator counter; unknown/comment/nested/duplicate formats reject. Keep producer/catalog authority synthetic and explicit, real physical approval false, actual SQL count zero until a raw remote native result is independently accepted.
